maintenance_led.reason: Mostly new-build products: Arcadia architectural windows and curtain walls, and DynaEnergetics perforating systems for new wells.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private construction and oil and gas firms; Arcadia sells to commercial and luxury residential projects.

serial_acquirer.reason: Three operating businesses (Arcadia, DynaEnergetics, NobelClad) that grow mainly through their own products and sales, not regular acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Architectural windows and well completion products are bought per project and competitively, so customers can switch suppliers fairly easily.

notes: Arcadia and DynaEnergetics are similar in size, so the answers for the larger part are less certain.
